mediaPage.boilerplateText: Mat Atom Deweloper Wrocław is a women's cycling team from Wrocław, Poland, founded in 2016. It holds a UCI Continental licence and runs a junior team, so riders develop within one squad from U19 to elite. The team races UCI events across Europe and national competitions on the road, on the track and in cyclocross. It is a member of the Club Pro programme of Poland's Ministry of Sport and Tourism and Fundacja Lotto. The title sponsor is Mat Atom Deweloper.
